'''Acatal''' was a barren, rocky [[Planet/Legends|planet]], and the second world in the [[Elrood system/Legends|Elrood system]]. It was owned by [[Radell Mining Corporation]], which [[Mining/Legends|extracted]] raw [[Ore/Legends|ores]].
